documents.population: International Student Track (applicant and both parents of foreign nationality), Yonsei University Office of Admissions, all majors and departments including the College of Computing
documents.notes: Yonsei Office of Admissions 'Fall Semester 2026 Application Guide for International Students' (PDF on www2.yonsei.ac.kr), section IV 'Application Materials'. Fall 2026 is the latest guide found on an official host on 2026-10-19: a Spring 2027 international admission ran in September 2026 but its guide's URL was not found, and no Fall 2027 guide exists yet. The guide says the Korean text takes precedence. Not drafted (no vocabulary kind): Academic History Record sheet (essential, completed online); High School Course Completion Certificate (only relevant applicants); parents' passports and the official document of the applicant-parent relationship (birth certificate; for Chinese nationals proof of kinship and household register; for Japanese nationals the family register); documents for foreigners with a history of Korean nationality; nationality documents for foreign residents in Korea; COA (D-2 visa) documents after admission; Chinese HUIKAO certificate. Admitted students expected to graduate must send the graduation certificate and final transcripts by mail after admission. Translations made by the applicant are not accepted. TOEFL/SAT/AP/ACT/IELTS scores must be reported officially (ETS/College Board 9893, ACT 7879). Underwood International College (uic.yonsei.ac.kr) is a separate track and its pages were not read (robots.txt disallows the site except a few top pages, and the allowed /admission.php returns an error page). In round 2 robots.txt refused uic.yonsei.ac.kr; this guide is on www2.yonsei.ac.kr, read with robots.txt honoured.
